Commentary.Commentary: 199 to chase for the home side. Can they do it and qualify for the T20 World Cup Down Under? Stay tuned...

George Munsey is down for an interview. He starts by saying that he is happy to get another half century. Points that the tournament has been tough for them and adds that he is happy to be able to score runs. On his reverse sweeps, he says that a couple of fielders were inside the 30-yard circle and that made him go for those shots. Adds that they have a big total on the board now and it is up to�the bowlers to defend it out.

Where did it go wrong for the hosts? Probably when George Munsey got out. Because at that stage, the opposition was going at around 8 an over but have ended up at almost 10 an over, thanks to the Berrington onslaught. The bowling was not at its best and was taken to the cleaners.

It all started from the very beginning. Munsey and Coetzer added 87 for the opening wicket and that set the platform. UAE looked like they had things under control but then, Richie Berrington came out and played a wonderful cameo. His 18-ball 48 was the tone which was required and Scotland just took off from there. The last 5 overs yielded 71, so you can imagine what carnage it was.
198. Wow. That is some total from the Scots. Have they sealed the deal to go Down Under? The pitch is good for batting but chasing close to 200 in a knockout game, looks difficult.

OUT! RUN OUT! Full delivery outside off, Calum drives this towards the cover region and takes off for a single. Ahmed at cover has a shy at the bowler's end and hits. Calum was nowhere in the picture. With that, SCOTLAND FINISH ON 198 FOR 6.
FOUR! This is excellent batting from Calum! Flighted delivery outside off, Macleod makes room for himself and plays the sweep shot towards the fine leg region for a boundary.

DROPPED! Flighted delivery on middle, Calum looks to loft it over the long on region for a maximum but does not get the required elevation on it. Sultan Ahmed settles himself under it but makes a mess of it. The batters take a couple.
Four! Flighted delivery on middle, Calum plays another lovely sweep towards the deep square leg region for another boundary.

FOUR! Brilliantly played! Low full toss on middle, Calum goes down on his knees and plays a lovely sweep shot towards the deep square leg region for a boundary. The fielder tries to stop it with a dive but fails to stop it.
Full delivery on middle, Cross looks to flick it towards the leg side but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
Short of a length delivery, MacLeod looks to pull but gets a top edge. It lands safely towards mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, MacLeod pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, MacLeod pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Short delivery on middle, Cross pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, MacLeod cuts it through point. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR BYES! On a good length and outside off, MacLeod looks to cut but misses it. It goes towards Boota who fails to collect and it goes past him for a boundary.
Matthew Cross walks out to bat next.

OUT! BOWLED! Tom Sole is the latest man to go. He had to go for the big shots but perishes. Flighted ball on middle, Tom looks to play the paddle sweep but fails to put any bat on it. The ball rolls on to hit the leg stump. Mixed over comes to an end.
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
FOUR! Flighted delivery on middle, Tom gets off the mark with sweep towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Tom Sole is the new batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED! Good comeback from Mustafa! Bowls a fullish delivery on middle, Berrington makes room for himself towards the off side to play the paddle sweep but misses it completely. The ball goes onto hit the middle stump. Berrington perishes after playing a magnificent innings.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Flighted delivery outside off, Berrington lofts this over the cover fielder and into the fence. Good start to the over.
Fullish delivery outside off, Berrington pushes it towards the point region and takes three. The fielder comes around and cleans it up.
Rohan Mustafa is back on. 2-0-10-0 are his figures so far.
FOUR! Another brilliant delivery on middle, Berrington drives this straight down the ground and into the long off fence.

FOUR! Nicely played! Short ball on middle, Berrington pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. The fielder at deep mid-wicket tries to catch it with one hand but does not get to it.
Full delivery on middle, Richie drives it to long on and takes a couple. Excellent running.
WIDE! Slower short ball aimed at the body but it bounces way over the batsman. Berrington lets it go to the keeper. It is wided.
Short ball outside off, Macleod punches it towards the third man region for a single.
Short ball outside off, Berrington pushes it towards the cover region and takes a single.
Calum MacLeod is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Leask falls in trying to continue attacking! Slower delivery outside off, Leask looks to loft it over the deep mid-wicket fielder but does not time it well. The ball goes high in the air and Waheed Ahmed settles under it. He takes a simple catch.
Zahoor Khan is back on. 2-0-16-0 are his figures so far.
Full delivery on middle, Berrington flicks it towards the leg side and takes a couple. 18 runs have come off this one. Excellent one for Scotland.
SIX! Brilliant shot! Good length ball outside off, Berrington plays a lovely lofted shot over the long off fielder for the second maximum of the over. This is excellent batting from the Scottish.
Good length ball outside off, Berrington looks to loft this but it goes off the edge towards deep extra cover. By the time the fielder can get to it, the batters take a couple.
Short ball outside off, Leask pulls it towards the leg side for a single.
Short ball outside off, Richie plays a lofted shot towards the cover region for a single.
SIX! BANG! Berrington says thank you very much! Waheed bowls this full on off, Berrington plays the slog over the mid-wicket region for another maximum. Brilliant start to the over.
Waheed Ahmed is back into the attack. 2-0-19-0 are his figures so far.
Good length ball outside off, Berrington lofts this towards the cover region for a single.
EDGED AND FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler. Full delivery outside off, Berrington looks to drive it but it goes off the outside edge towards the third man region for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Leask drives this uppishly towards long on and takes a single.
Full delivery outside off, Leask drives it towards the cover fielder.
Full toss on off, Berrington drives it through mid off. The batsmen take a single.
Full delivery on middle, Leask lofts it over mid on. The fielder at long on collects in one bounce. The batsmen cross ends.
Junaid Siddique is back on. 3-0-28-1 are his figures so far.
SIX! Nice shot! Floated ball outside off, Berrington times his lofted shot towards the extra cover region for a huge maximum.
Flighted ball outside off, Berrington plays the extra cover drive over the extra cover region. The batters take a couple.
Flatter delivery on middle, Berrington flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a couple before the fielder can clean it up.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery outside off, Berrington looks to cut it but fails to get any bat on it.
Richie Berrington is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch! That is a one-handed stunner! Raza bowls a flighted ball on off, Munsey looks to play the lofted shot over long off and it seemed like going over the fence but Rameez Shahzad, stationed at long off, jumps high in the air and plucks it out with one hand. Excellent innings though comes to an end from Munsey. Will this change fortunes for the hosts?
Flatter delivery on middle, Leask works it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Ahmed Raza is back on. 2-0-16-0 are his figures so far.
Full delivery on middle, George flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes another couple.
Good length ball outside off, Munsey looks to defend it but it goes off the outside edge which goes towards third man for a couple.

SIX! WOAH! Switch hit off a fast bowler! How many times do you see this? Low full toss on middle, Munsey goes down on his knees and plays the switch hit towards the third man region for another maximum. The ball has been lost and the umpires have called for new balls.
Slower short ball outside off, Munsey looks to play it at first but decides to let it go the keeper.
Slower short delivery outside off, Leask pulls it towards the deep square leg region for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Munsey flicks it towards the long on region and takes a single.
Short ball on middle, Munsey pulls it towards the leg side and takes a single.
Full delivery outside off, Leask drives it towards the cover region and takes a single.

SIX! Leask has been sent out with an agenda here! First ball and he hits a six! This is brilliant. Short delivery on middle, Leask rocks on his back foot and pulls it with disdain towards the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Short ball on off, Munsey comes down the track to defend but the ball bounces on him and hits the gloves. The ball rolls towards third man and the batters take a single.
Michael Leask is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Coetzer goes after playing a handy knock. UAE desperately needed a wicket here as these two were taking the game away from them. Good length ball outside off, Kyle makes room for himself and looks to loft it over the long off fielder but does not time it well. Muhammad Usman runs in and takes a simple catch.
Short delivery on middle, Munsey pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a single.
WIDE! Siddique bowls a full delivery down the leg side, Munsey lets the ball go to the keeper. It is wided.
Junaid Siddique is back on. 2-0-17-0 are his figures so far.
BEATEN! Slower delivery on the middle stump line, Kyle makes room for himeslf towards the off side and looks to play the scoop shot but fails to put any bat on it.
Short ball outside off, Munsey pushes it off the back foot towards the off side and takes a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kyle pulls it towards the long on region and crosses over for a single.

FIFTY! Fifth one for Munsey in T20Is! This has been an excellent innings from the opener and what a time to get it. Need to win this match to qualify and George has delivered for his side. Slower short ball on off, Munsey pulls it towards the deep square leg region and takes a single.
Full delivery on off, Kyle moves towards the off side this time and flicks it towards long on and takes a single.
Short ball outside off, Kyle makes room for himself and cuts it but straight to the point fielder.
Zahoor Khan is into the attack for the first time.
SIX! Second maximum of the over. On a length on middle, Munsey lofts it over square leg for a biggie. 16 runs have come from this over and 27 runs have come from the last two overs.
Length delivery outside off, Coetzer punches it towards point. The batsmen take a single.
On a length on off, Munsey plays it towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
SIX! Massive hit! Length delivery on middle, Munsey lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket for a maximum.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Munsey again looks to play the switch hit but misses it.
Length delivery on off, Munsey looks to play a switch hit but gets it of the outer half of the bat. It goes towards covers. The batsmen get two runs.

FOUR! Now its Coetzer's turn to play the reverse sweep. Raza bowls a full delivery on the middle stump line, Kyle goes on his knees and plays the reverse sweep towards the backward point region for a boundary. The fielder runs in from deep cover to stop but fails to do so. A boundary after 26 balls for the Scottish.
Loopy ball on middle, George flicks it towards the leg side and crosses over for another single.
Full delivery on middle, Kyle sweeps it towards the deep square leg region and takes a single.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Munsey looks to sweep it but it goes off the top edge towards short fine leg. The batters take a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Kyle plays a sweep towards the fine leg region and takes three. The fielder runs after it and makes a good sliding stop before it reaches the ropes.
Flighted delivery on the pads, Munsey bends down on his knees and plays a conventional sweep towards backward square leg for a single.
Another slower one outside off, Kyle waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single. Good over from Waheed comes to an end.
Slower delivery outside off, Kyle looks to guide it towards the third man region but fails to put any bat on it.
Full delivery outside off, Kyle drives this beautifully towards the deep cover region for a couple. Chirag Suri runs in from deep cover-point and makes an excellent diving stop.
Good length delivery on middle, George flicks it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Slower delivery outside off, George looks to play a reverse sweep of a medium pace bowler but gets hit on the gloves and into the pitch. No run.
Good length ball on middle, Munsey pushes it back to the bowler.
Waheed Ahmed comes into the attack.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.

Flatter delivery on middle, Kyle flicks it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single. 50-run partnership comes up between the two. Excellent stand and they would look to continue to go big here.
Floated ball on the pads, Munsey looks to play the conventional sweep but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. The batters take a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Coetzer flicks it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single.
BEATEN! Raza bowls this with a bit of air outside off, Kyle looks to cut it off the back foot but fails to put any bat on it.
Full delivery on the pads, Munsey flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Ahmed Raza is into the attack.
Full delivery outside off, Kyle pushes it towards point. 46 runs have come off the Powerplay.
Full delivery on off, Coetzer drives it towards mid off for nothing.
Flighted ball on middle, George plays the reverse sweep again but finds the short third man fielder. The batsmen take a single.
Another full delivery on off, George drives it to mid off for nothing.
Full delivery on middle, George makes room for himself and drives this towards the cover fielder for nothing.
Flatter delivery on middle, Coetzer works it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Short ball on middle, Kyle pulls it towards the leg side and crosses over for a single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, George looks to flick it but it goes off the inside edge onto his pads. They take a single.
Short ball on middle, Kyle looks to pull it but gets a top edge towards the mid on region. The fielder goes at it with one hand to catch it but fails to reach it.

FOUR! Hammered! Full delivery outside off, Kyle drives this crisply towards the cover region for another boundary. The fielder at cover dives to stop the ball but it races past him  and into the fence.
Short ball aimed at the body, Coetzer looks to hook it but does not make any connection to it.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Coetzer looks to cut it but fails to get any bat on it.
Junaid Siddique has a change of ends.
FOUR! Nicely played from Munsey! Flighted delivery on middle, George drives it off the front foot towards long on and gets another boundary. 37 runs off the first four overs.
Full delivery on middle, Munsey drives this towards the long on region and takes a couple.
Flighted delivery on middle, Kyle flicks it to the leg side and takes a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Munsey punches this off the back foot towards the off side for a single.
Full delivery on middle, George pushes it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery outside off, George drives it towards the cover region. No run.
Rohan Mustafa is into the attack.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full delivery outside off, George drives this crisply towards the cover fielder for nothing.
FOUR! Great batting this from Munsey! Conventional shot this time. Floated delivery on the pads, Munsey gets on his knees and plays a sweep shot over the short fine leg fielder for another boundary.
SIX! This is brilliant batting from George! Another flighted delivery on middle, Munsey plays another switch hit and plays it over the backward point region for the second maximum of the over.
Flighted delivery on off, George looks to play the switch hit again but finds the third man fielder.
SIX! What a shot from Munsey! Flighted delivery on the pads, Munsey times his switch hit and lofts this towards the deep cover-point region for the first maximum of the game.
Full delivery outside off, Kyle drives this towards the third man fielder and by the time the fielder can come around to clean it up, the batters take a couple.

FOUR! That is an unusual shot from the skipper! Short ball outside off, Kyle plays a short arm jab over the bowler's head for a boundary. He did not time it well but had enough to reach the fence. The mid off and mid on fielders try to chase it down but fail to do so.
Short delivery on middle, Coetzer looks to pull it but it goes off the bottom edge of his bat towards the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Kyle pushes it towards the point fielder.
Short ball on middle which hurried on to the batsman, Kyle looks to pull but it goes off the inside half of his bat towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Brilliant shot from Coetzer! Siddique starts with a short delivery way outside off, Kyle stands tall and punches this towards the deep cover-point region for the first boundary of the game.
Junaid Siddique to bowl from the other end. George Munsey had a concussion test and he is fine to continue.
Another flighted ball on off, George looks to play the reverse sweep but gets hit on the edge of the bat going on to hit the helmet. Good start from UAE.
Floated ball down the leg side, Munsey looks to play the reverse sweep but fails to put any bat on it.
Flighted ball on middle, Coetzer pushes it towards mid on and takes a single. He gets off the mark.
Flat delivery outside off which kept very low, Kyle drives it towards point.
Flat delivery on off, Kyle defends it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Starts with a flat delivery on middle and leg, Munsey gets off the mark by working this towards deep mid-wicket.
We are all set to begin! George Munsey and Kyle Coetzer make their way out to the middle. The UAE players follow them out. Sultan Ahmed will start the proceedings for the hosts.

Pitch report - Bazid Khan is there for the pitch report. He says that this pitch favours batting. Adds that the average first innings score is 161. Further says that the pitch might suit the faster bowlers. He is joined by Ed Rainsford who says that the pitch is hard and the curator has done a good job letting a little bit of grass on the surface.

Ahmed Raza, the UAE skipper, says that sometimes it is okay to lose the toss. Further says that he had a simple chat with the boys and told them that one bad day will happen. Adds that Chirag Suri is in for Zawar Farid.

Kyle Coetzer, the Scotland skipper, says they are going to bat first. Says that the pitch looks good and they would look to put runs on the board. On pressure games, it is not an ideal position to be in but they will look to do well. Adds that Coetzer says to let the players enjoy themselves

United Arab Emirates (PLAYING XI) - Rohan Mustafa, Chirag Suri (IN FOR ZAWAR FARID), Rameez Shahzad, Muhammad Usman, Darius D'Silva, Waheed Ahmed, Mohammad Boota (WK), Ahmed Raza (C), Sultan Ahmed, Junaid Siddique, Zahoor Khan.

Scotland (PLAYING XI) - George Munsey, Kyle Coetzer (C), Calum MacLeod, Richie Berrington, Michael Leask, Matthew Cross(WK), Tom Sole (IN FOR CRAIG WALLACE), Safyaan Sharif, Josh Davey, Mark Watt, Alasdair Evans.
Toss - Up goes the coin and Scotland have won the toss. They have chosen to bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the third qualifying playoff between Scotland and UAE. The hosts were hammered in their previous game against the Dutch but all is not lost for them. If they win this fixture, they will get on the plane to Australia but if they lose, they are out of reckoning. Scotland are coming into this game after finishing fourth in their group. They have no chance of playing the final but winning this will help them qualify for the World T20 in Australia. Losing will mean that they will not be able to qualify for the ICC World T20. Both the teams need to give their best in order to have a chance. Who will come out trumps? The Scottish or the hosts. Join us in a while to find out.
